correctness.rationale: Reconstructing the staircase from a named choice of side, successive nonempty neighborhood differences give the opposite blocks and the incidence j≤i. Connectedness and the existence of an edge give exactly two side choices and no empty neighborhoods. Proper neighborhood inclusion is definable with three names and occurs only within a side. Its recursively defined finite chain ranks give m and define exactly A_(r+1) and B_(m−r) at rank r. To test at least s≤k twins, bind s distinct vertices and compare every pair's neighborhoods; the bound third name inside each comparison can shadow another witness without affecting its other occurrences. The existential and universal rank tests recover the lesser and greater clipped block sizes at each rank. If some rank has two different clipped sizes, the appropriate threshold defines one block there; sharing a neighbor with a member of that block defines its whole side because the nonempty neighborhoods on each side are nested. Using this same side formula at all ranks gives a globally consistent orientation; if every rank pair is equal, orientation is immaterial. Conversely after aligning the clipped staircases, keep the equality and block assignment of current pebbles. At most k−1 distinct vertices are retained before placement, so even a saturated block has room for a new distinct witness; unsaturated blocks agree in size. This is an indefinite partial-isomorphism strategy. Each fixed string under the side-swap/reversal is determined by its first side, so the orbit count is (k^(2m)+k^m)/2. Truncation uniquely minimizes all block sizes in the orbit, and the stated star pair separates at k+1. Inspected VERIFICATION.md and both source/output pairs without executing bundled code. The 819 staircase cases and 524 plain-logic instances are finite corroboration; the proof supplies the unbounded result.

value.rationale: The result classifies an unbounded-level natural graph family and makes explicit which aspects of the staircase survive a finite-variable observation budget. Aligning the unnamed sides is necessary: unordered size pairs at individual ranks do not in general specify a single global orientation. The classification gives a usable canonical compression, exact per-level counts, and sharp width witnesses. The elementary Burnside computation is a consequence, not the sole contribution.
